```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

tag_col <- c("Fluency" = "cnavy",
             "Human-Centric" = "cpurple",
             "Agility" = "camber")

emit_cards <- function(icons, colors, titles, bodies, width, bigs = NULL) {
  n <- length(titles)
  gap <- if (n > 1) (1 - n * width) / (n - 1) else 0
  parts <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    paste0(
      "\\begin{minipage}[t]{", sprintf("%.4f", width), "\\linewidth}\\raggedright\n",
      "\\begin{cardbox}{", colors[i], "}\n",
      if (!is.null(bigs)) paste0("\\bignum{", colors[i], "}{", bigs[i], "}\n") else "",
      "\\cardhead{", colors[i], "}{", icons[i], "}{", titles[i], "}\n",
      bodies[i],
      "\n\\end{cardbox}\n\\end{minipage}"
    )
  }, character(1))
  cat(paste(parts,
            collapse = paste0("\\hspace{", sprintf("%.4f", gap), "\\linewidth}")),
      "\n", sep = "")
}

item_box <- function(tag, title, body) {
  col <- unname(tag_col[[tag]])
  paste0(
    "\\begin{citem}{", col, "}\n",
    "\\ckbox\\chip{", col, "}{", tag, "}\\ ",
    "\\textcolor{", col, "}{\\textbf{", title, ".}}\\ ",
    body,
    "\n\\end{citem}\n"
  )
}

emit_checklist <- function(df) {
  items <- paste(
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)),
           function(i) item_box(df$tag[i], df$title[i], df$body[i]),
           character(1)),
    collapse = "")
  cat(items, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: why-now

cat("\\sechead{cnavy}{Why this matters now}\n")
emit_cards(
  icons  = c("chart-line", "graduation-cap", "briefcase"),
  colors = c("cnavy", "cred", "cgreen"),
  titles = c("Demographic cliff", "Debt \\& value", "Entry-level, redefined"),
  bodies = c(
    "Fewer high school graduates nationally by 2041 \\textbf{13\\%} --- about 1\\% every year --- with no good replacement revenue as enrollment falls.",
    "CSUEB graduates leave with about \\textbf{\\$16,000} in debt, repaid over roughly 8 years, while public confidence in college's value keeps eroding.",
    "AI is redefining entry-level work \\textbf{right now}: graduates will be expected to handle complex, judgment-based tasks from day one."
  ),
  width = 0.318,
  bigs  = c("13\\%", "\\$16K", "\\faIcon{briefcase}")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: part-a-list
#| results: asis
part_a <- data.frame(
  tag = c(
    "Fluency", "Fluency", "Fluency", "Fluency", "Fluency",
    "Fluency", "Fluency", "Fluency", "Fluency", "Agility"
  ),
  title = c(
    "Try two tools hands-on",
    "Grade your own assignment",
    "Practice iterative prompting",
    "Learn the failure modes",
    "Know the privacy rules",
    "Read the campus AI policy",
    "Attend one AI teaching workshop",
    "Read one substantial piece",
    "Explore discipline tools",
    "Keep an experiment log"
  ),
  body = c(
    "Use two AI tools for a real task this term --- the university ChatGPT account, Microsoft Copilot, or Google Gemini --- not a demo.",
    "Run one of your own assignments through AI. Note what it gets right, what it fabricates, and where students would stumble.",
    "Give context, specify the format, request revisions. Keep a short log of prompts that worked and why.",
    "Hallucinated citations, confident wrong math, hidden assumptions --- build a personal verification habit you can teach.",
    "Never paste student data, unpublished research, or personnel information into public tools. Know what campus licenses.",
    "Read it end to end --- plus your department's expectations for disclosure and attribution.",
    "A Faculty Development session, the Back to the Bay series, or a workshop in your discipline.",
    "An EDUCAUSE or discipline-journal article on teaching with AI --- steal two ideas you can use.",
    "For statistics and data science: AI analysis assistants, code copilots for R and Python, AI features in Quarto and Posit.",
    "One page a month: what worked, what you would teach, and what you would warn students about."
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
emit_checklist(part_a)
```
